_comment: Modelled, not observed. The running speed and dwell are measured from the
TfC feed's own M1 and M2 trips so Line 3 is consistent with the rest of the
graph; the headway windows are modelled on M2's window shape. Every window
below is a per-branch headway: trains alternate at Kit Kat, so the trunk
sees twice this frequency. Replace with published figures when we have them.
